annotations.title: Hand a chat to a person

description: Puts one conversation, named by id, in a person’s hands: control human means a person holds it and the AI assistant and automations stop answering in it; control pending_human marks it as waiting for a person to pick up. reason says why, and pause_bot_until holds the assistant back until a time. It hands the chat to a person; the chat stays with people from then on. Nothing is sent to the customer. Returns the conversation.

id.description: The id in the resource path.
